# Terraform Cloudflare Network

> Load balancing, health monitors, Spectrum applications, Magic WAN, and Magic Transit.

Terraform module for Cloudflare, maintained by CloudDrove. Source: `terraform-cf-modules/network/cloudflare`. Repository: https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-network

Requires Terraform >= 1.12.0 (or OpenTofu >= 1.12) and the `cloudflare/cloudflare` provider ~> 5.24. Provider v5 renamed most resources from v4, so verify resource names against the current provider docs rather than older examples.

## Usage

```hcl
module "this" {
  source  = "terraform-cf-modules/network/cloudflare"
  version = "~> 0.1"
}
```

## Submodules

Each is separately addressable with the double slash source syntax.

- [addressing](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-network/tree/main/modules/addressing): `terraform-cf-modules/network/cloudflare//modules/addressing`
- [load-balancer](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-network/tree/main/modules/load-balancer): `terraform-cf-modules/network/cloudflare//modules/load-balancer`
- [magic-transit](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-network/tree/main/modules/magic-transit): `terraform-cf-modules/network/cloudflare//modules/magic-transit`
- [magic-wan](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-network/tree/main/modules/magic-wan): `terraform-cf-modules/network/cloudflare//modules/magic-wan`
- [monitor](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-network/tree/main/modules/monitor): `terraform-cf-modules/network/cloudflare//modules/monitor`
- [monitoring](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-network/tree/main/modules/monitoring): `terraform-cf-modules/network/cloudflare//modules/monitoring`
- [pool](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-network/tree/main/modules/pool): `terraform-cf-modules/network/cloudflare//modules/pool`
- [spectrum](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-network/tree/main/modules/spectrum): `terraform-cf-modules/network/cloudflare//modules/spectrum`
